There’s an important mismatch: Call.com Telecom Limited is a UK telecommunications/eSIM company, not a managed business-travel provider. Its product is mobile data/communications for travellers, and its terms explicitly describe the service as mobile data rather than travel management. 
Companies House
+1

Provider	Current price	Key exclusions/limitations	Best fit
Call.com	eSIM plans are priced individually; no corporate travel-management price published	No flight/hotel booking, approvals, GST travel reporting or TMC servicing	Travel connectivity only, not travel management
MakeMyTrip myBiz	₹0 annual subscription; booking/service fees apply by agreement; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Corporate features depend on negotiated fares; not a full traditional TMC	50-person firms wanting self-service + support
Yatra for Business	Quote-based for Travel Pro; covers businesses under ₹5 crore annual travel spend 
Yatra.com
	Exact service fees require quotation	SMEs needing policies, approvals and GST reporting
Offistrip Growth	₹7,999/month (₹95,988/year) 
Offistrip
	Custom integrations and implementation may cost extra	50-person firms wanting explicit subscription pricing and governance

Bottom line: if you intended Call.com as a travel-connectivity supplier, it isn't directly comparable to these TMCs.

For an Indian couple, I’d shortlist these three:

Option	Indicative cost	What you get	Refund/cancellation
Atlys	Service fee varies	Document review, appointment, submission support, tracking	100% refund before government submission; eligible rejections covered by AtlysProtect. 
Atlys
+1

MakeMyTrip	Quote-dependent + govt fee	Visa assistance through established travel platform	Service fee becomes non-refundable once Booking ID is generated; visa fee refundable only until filing. 
MakeMyTrip Visa

VFS Global	Govt fee + centre/service charges	Official application-centre processing where appointed by the consulate	Cancellation/refund rules vary by country/centre; verify before paying. 
VFS Global

Before paying: get the exact couple price, appointment/embassy fee, courier charges, refund trigger, and whether rejection protection covers government fees too. VFS is the application centre, not the visa decision-maker.
